evidence.reason: Production read-back after PR #916 confirms the Ivan Mazepa Activity endpoint is now 1709, but the pre-existing notes still state that the Activity ended with his 1708 break with Peter I. Align the notes with the corrected rules + Hetman + reign interval while preserving the Activity identity and all other fields.
evidence.source: Encyclopedia of Ukraine, Ivan Mazepa; Hetman

expected_before.notes: Ivan Mazepa was Hetman of the Cossack Hetmanate from 1687 until his break with Peter I in 1708. The user label 'Zaporozhia' is normalized to the Cossack Hetmanate, the polity he actually governed; he was not the ruler of the Zaporozhian Sich.

expected_after.notes: Ivan Mazepa was Hetman of the Cossack Hetmanate from 1687 to 1709. He broke with Peter I in 1708; ATLAS retains 1709 as the end of this Hetman/reign Activity rather than treating the break itself as the end of his hetmancy. The user label 'Zaporozhia' is normalized to the Cossack Hetmanate, the polity he actually governed; he was not the ruler of the Zaporozhian Sich.
